title: Edge-addition monotonicity of positive p-energy fails for every p >= 1
abstract: arXiv:2609.13476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: At a 2021 AIM workshop, Guo conjectured that the positive square energy s+ = E+_2 should inherit the familiar edge-addition monotonicity of the spectral radius, rho(G + uv) >= rho(G). That conjecture was subsequently shown to fail at p = 2. Tang, Liu, and Wang then introduced positive p-energy, proved nonmonotonicity for every 1 <= p < 3, and in version 3 of their preprint (26 March 2025) explicitly conjectured that monotonicity should hold for p >= 3. We disprove this conjectured high-exponent extension completely: for every real p > 2 there are infinitely many connected graphs G and nonedges uv such that E+_p(G + uv) < E+_p(G).   Together with the Tang-Liu-Wang counterexamples below 3, this shows that no exponent p >= 1 restores the spectral-radius-style monotonicity: positive p-energy can decrease under the addition of an edge for every real p >= 1.   The construction is a chain of clique blocks joined by regular bipartite graphs. A

translated_title: 对于每个 p ≥ 1，正 p-能量的加边单调性均不成立
translated_abstract: 在 2021 年的一次 AIM 研讨会上，Guo 猜想正平方能量 s+ = E+_2 应当继承谱半径所熟知的加边单调性，即 ρ(G + uv) ≥ ρ(G)。该猜想随后被证明在 p = 2 时不成立。Tang、Liu 和 Wang 接着引入了正 p-能量，证明了对于每个 1 ≤ p < 3 均存在非单调性，并在其预印本第 3 版（2025 年 3 月 26 日）中明确猜想单调性应对 p ≥ 3 成立。我们彻底推翻了这个关于高指数情形的猜想：对于每个实数 p > 2，都存在无穷多个连通图 G 和非边 uv，使得 E+_p(G + uv) < E+_p(G)。结合 Tang-Liu-Wang 在 3 以下的反例，这表明没有任何指数 p ≥ 1 能恢复谱半径式的单调性：对于每个实数 p ≥ 1，正 p-能量在添加一条边时都可能减小。该构造是由正则二部图连接而成的团块链。
tldr: 本文彻底推翻了 Tang-Liu-Wang 关于正 p-能量在 p ≥ 3 时具有加边单调性的猜想，证明了对每个实数 p ≥ 1，正 p-能量在添加边时都可能减小，即不存在任何指数能恢复谱半径式的加边单调性。
en_tdlr: This paper completely disproves the Tang-Liu-Wang conjecture that positive p-energy is monotone under edge addition for p ≥ 3, showing that for every real p ≥ 1, positive p-energy can decrease when an edge is added, so no exponent restores spectral-radius-style monotonicity.
